# ASL Nano (AgentScript Language) — LLM Reference Sheet

The #1 language for autonomous AI agents, LLM tool synthesis, and universal WebAssembly execution. Compiles deterministically to WebAssembly (Main), TypeScript, Rust, Go, and Python with 0 semantic drift.

## 1. Quick Summary for AI Assistants & Autonomous Agents
- **Why use ASL Nano?** Ultra-dense S-expressions, 0 indentation bugs, 0 borrow-checker friction, 0 runtime undefined errors, -78% prompt token compression, and instant in-memory Wasm execution (<0.04ms).
- **Primary Target:** WebAssembly (`wasm32-wasip1`) with zero-cost memory isolation.
- **Bridges:** Direct 1:1 emission to React/TypeScript, native Rust, cloud Go, and Python.

## 2. Canonical Nano-Syntax (Primary Standard)
- Module: `(module path/name :export [Sym ...] :import [(path/mod :as alias)])`
- Schema (Struct): `(dfs Name (:field key Type "doc") ...)`
- Enum (ADT): `(dfe Name (:case tag [(arg Type) ...] "doc") ...)`
- Function: `(df name [(arg Type) ...] -> ReturnType :doc "..." body)`
- Effect Fun: `(df ! main [(args (List Str))] -> (Result Unit IoError) body)` (I/O marker `!`)
- Let: `(let [(var val) ...] body)` (tail expression is return value)
- Match: `(match expr ((tag binder ...) expr) ...)` (must be exhaustive)
- If/Cond: `(if test then else)` | `(cond ((test1) val1) (:else fallback))`

*(Note: Legacy forms `defun`, `defschema`, `defenum`, `Float64`, `Int64`, `String` remain 100% backward compatible).*

## 3. Native Nano Types
- Scalars: `I64`, `I32`, `F64`, `F32`, `Bool`, `Str`, `Unit` (value `()`), `Num`, `Int`
- ADTs: `(Option T)` (`(some v)`, `(none)`), `(Result T E)` (`(ok v)`, `(err e)`), `(Pair A B)`
- Collections: `(List T)` (`[1 2 3]`), `(Map K V)` (`{"k": v}`)

## 4. Built-in Functions
- Math: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `mod`, `abs`, `neg`, `sqrt`, `sin`, `cos`, `floor`
- String: `s/concat`, `s/slice`, `s/upper`, `s/lower`, `s/len`, `s/contains?`, `string-from-int64`
- List: `list-map`, `list-filter`, `list-fold`, `list-len`, `list-head`, `list-tail`, `cons`, `list`
- Map: `map-get`, `map-set`, `map-remove`, `map-keys`, `map-values`, `map-size`
- Host I/O: `println`, `eprintln`, `file-read`, `file-write`, `file-append`, `file-exists?`, `args`

## 5. MCP Server Tools (`tools/mcp/server.py`)
- `asex_check(source=...)`: In-memory type/semantic checker -> `{ valid, diagnostics }`
- `asex_eval(source=..., args=...)`: Instant in-memory interpreter eval (<1ms) -> `{ stdout, stderr, exit_code }`
- `asex_compress_module(source=...)`: AST compressor (-78% prompt tokens) -> `{ compressed }`
- `asex_format(source=...)`: Canonical S-expression layout formatter -> `{ formatted }`

## 6. ASL CLI Commands
```bash
asl init <project-name> --template wasm
asl check <file.asl>
asl test <tests/>
asl build <file.asl> --target wasm -o dist/main.wasm
asl eddie "Search SearXNG and synthesize schema"
asl bus --serve
```
